preference: Substantial end-to-end PR batches with named cohorts and measurable outcomes.

batches.title: Expand the moon roster by 26
batches.outcome: 26 new standalone moons merged; roster 69 → 95, benchmark coverage 90/461.
batches.scope: 18 Saturn irregulars, four Uranus irregulars, and four asteroid/dwarf-planet companions.
batches.delivery: A complete source-backed body package for every selected target: physical-model interpretation, parent-relative orbit, orientation limits, preparation, retained rendering, navigation, content, thumbnails, source restoration and qualification evidence.
batches.closure: Resolve actual source identities, scale, axes, frame, orbit window and any selected ancillary-file terms for all 26 before expensive preparation. Use the reviewed mesh or explicitly observation-constrained approximation. Published minimum elongation, assumed polar dimension and tentative spin must remain visible; this batch does not promise 26 measured terrain surfaces.
batches.acceptance: All 26 have standalone routes and reproducible inputs; package/registry counts match; independent physical/orbit anchors and real Chrome DPR 1/2 evidence cover every new object. Preserve one generic adapter and one mounted scene.

batches.title: Add scientific surfaces and terrain to 13 moons
batches.outcome: 13 existing worlds gain a substantive scientific layer or source-backed geometry improvement.
batches.scope: Facet-relative albedo/slope for the Mars moons and Dimorphos; lunar numeric/science products; Europa terrain or spectra; mapped geology; Saturnian shape/relief; Charon color/composition.
batches.delivery: Ship the shared preparation capabilities together with their body-specific consumers. Complete selected geometry/lenses, validity and confidence treatment, units/datums, scientific legends, thumbnails/minimaps and provenance as one user-visible surface upgrade.
batches.closure: Pin at least one genuinely new, supported product per body before freezing final implementation details. Resolve archive access and coordinate conventions; distinguish measured, interpolated and modeled support. Source-defined regional coverage and thermal local-time bins remain explicit.
batches.acceptance: Each of the 13 bodies demonstrates the promised new information with independent source-to-display checks. Geometry changes preserve map registration and interaction behavior. A presentation improvement must add supported information rather than simply resample an existing image.

aggregateFailures: Polymele source inputs and HTTP 500 route

scopeDecision.decision: User approved shipping the 13 prepared upgrades after review and carrying Titania and Miranda into the next substantial batch. Their exact GIS releases remain inaccessible, not absent.

batches.title: Add spacecraft color and scientific maps to six moons
batches.outcome: Six new selectable views and three improved existing views across six existing moons; no roster increase.
batches.scope: Callisto Galileo color; Hyperion close-image mosaic; Phoebe paired shape, relative albedo, radial height and coverage maps; Proteus filter color; Titania and Miranda registered geology.
batches.delivery: Deliver the observed views and all required camera/attitude, photometric, visibility and coverage preparation. Include source-frame comparisons and holdout registration evidence across the cohort. Any necessary shared registration improvements ship with these complete uses.
batches.closure: All twelve original targets have source dispositions. The six delivered bodies have pinned source and runtime closure; the exact Uranus GIS archives are retained. Unresolved registration and source limitations for the other six remain in the carry-forward queue.
batches.acceptance: Source-specific imagery and numeric/category maps retain honest coverage, units and registration limits. The six bodies have unit, source-closure, fresh-runtime and actual Chrome DPR1/2 evidence; full application gates remain explicitly incomplete.

aggregateLimits: Whole-application production build stopped by resource guard
Nine renderer fixture failures reproduced on unchanged main inputs; full renderer run stopped by resource guard
Full platform/shell and physical mobile qualification not completed in the resumed run

scopeDecision.decision: User agreed to open one draft PR for the six completed upgrades and carry the other six source dispositions forward.
scopeDecision.carriedTo: Unscheduled B3 source-research carry-forward queue; no new scene or mapped coverage promised.

batches.title: Add measured light curves and spectra across nine existing moons
batches.outcome: A complete prepared observation-chart capability used by nine existing moon packages.
batches.scope: JWST spectra, Ymir Cassini light curves, and Methone Cassini spectroscopy, preserving each instrument and observing sequence.
batches.delivery: Prepare numeric charts and uncertainty information ahead of runtime, integrate them through shared supported capabilities, and supply all nine body datasets and explanations. Each chart identifies the observed quantity, units, date/phase and inference limits.
batches.closure: Pin released numeric data or reproducible extraction inputs. The review identifies actual CSV/text for some targets and archive/reduction work for others. Normalize and validate each measurement on its own terms; disk-integrated spectra do not provide a spatial mineral map.
batches.acceptance: All nine bodies expose useful measured observations with source/error checks, accessible content and stable retained DOM. Runtime consumes prepared results. The feature is exercised end to end by the full cohort.
